title: 6704 bearing holder · 3 × 3 · 12 mm
variant: motor servo standard 01 horn adapter screws
scope: Quantities for one complete printed holder/adapter, plus its listed interface. Installation fasteners are application-specific.

bom.purpose: Print all hub pieces in 3dpr.stl once; preserve complementary faces
Use the specified shaft interface; motor and mounting hardware are not shown
CAD insert pockets: 4 mm diameter; choose compatible insert depth and fit
Length depends on the mating component and selected insert; do not bottom out
Match the servo thread and required engagement; length is servo-specific
At y = ±7.375 mm; choose length for the actual horn and hub

notes: This variant supplies the rotating adapter only. Provide a compatible stationary outer bearing support in the surrounding assembly.
No separate hub joining screws are modelled. Retain the hub with the mating shaft/interface hardware.
Bearing rings and fasteners are simplified nominal illustrations; threads, drive sockets, inserts and motor/interface hardware are omitted. Installation bolts depend on the surrounding assembly.
steps: Print one complete 3dpr.stl layout. Keep the complementary frame and hub pieces in their matching orientation.
Load any captive nuts, coupler nuts or inserts while their pockets are accessible. Seat each bearing between its matching hub and frame pieces.
Close the complementary pieces and fit the listed joining screws and nuts, following the alternating head and nut recesses.
Fit the specified shaft or motor interface. Check free rotation before fastening the holder to the surrounding structure.
